title: Super Bowl XLVIII
overview: Super Bowl XLVIII, played on February 2, 2014, at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey, saw the Seattle Seahawks dominate the Denver Broncos 43-8, capturing the franchise’s first-ever Super Bowl title in resounding fashion. Seattle’s victory was a masterclass in defensive execution, opportunistic offense, and relentless energy, all epitomized by the swagger of their “Legion of Boom” secondary and the poise of second-year quarterback Russell Wilson.
